context_files.purpose: Verbatim ruling to continue the mechanism and parenting program with simple hygiene while deferring completion and enforcement of the paper-grade guard to C11.
Normative V9 geometry, serialized surfaces, stage visibility, metric equations, classification, bounded hygiene, tests, resources, and claim boundary.
Requested implementation-only authority for exactly three source files, deterministic CPU tests, and V9-local reviews, with execution and C11 exclusions.

system_thesis_interpretation: V9 is implementation-determinate for the proposed three-file CPU scope. It asks whether four clean-base rank-8 writers can carry a complementary action rule keyed jointly by one of eight seen tool slots and one of two visible modes, while the exact scored multisets make each named one-factor and declared surface-covariate shortcut achieve only chance. The fixed slot-orientation tables, fully crossed surfaces, disjoint primary/oracle request types, total reducer, and bounded experiment-local integrity rules close the implementation forks material to this scout. Identifier spellings, exact prompt literals, and deterministic helper algorithms may be selected only as implementation bytes satisfying the stated invariants, then bound by hashes and exact human ratification; they do not redefine the geometry or label equations. A pass concerns supervised native-action behavior on the evaluated seen-key surface only and supplies no evidence of an internal representation, unseen-key generalization, memory, parenting, retention, recurrence, or a whole organism.
graph_delta_interpretation: The decisive graph change is to make abstract slot provenance precede identifier provenance. For each root, t0..t7, stratum membership, and the literal orientation bit are fixed by the two supplied tables; a separately named later-manifest identifier seed produces opaque identifiers that are assigned to those slots without recomputing or permuting orientation. Identifier mutation must therefore leave slot and orientation unchanged while changing the containing artifact hash. The target edge is exactly orientation XOR visible mode for W+ and its row-wise complement for W-. Training contains 128 rows per root-map fit and 512 rows overall; held primary evaluation contains 64 items per root-condition and 384 items overall. Every template and declared model-visible non-key categorical surface is crossed over slot/orientation, mode, and, where applicable, map, while roots have disjoint identifiers and literal surfaces. The evaluator graph is split: map-blind primary generation and likelihood read only held task bytes plus adapter/OFF state, whereas a separately typed OFF-oracle request alone reads the rendered correct map. Cache operation kinds and payload identities preserve that split. These constraints are sufficient for the three-file implementation without introducing C11 process, filesystem-threat, or release-control nodes.
loop_delta_interpretation: After exact human ratification, the current loop may author only gpu/multikey_writer_gateway_simple.sh, organism_v6/multikey_writer_gateway_simple.py, and tests/test_multikey_writer_gateway_simple.py, run deterministic CPU tests, and create bound V9-local reviews. The CPU loop materializes canonical crossed fixtures, checks byte projections and mutations, exercises tokenizer-interface behavior with fakes, replays all metric and label fixtures, and tests the enumerated local integrity faults. It must not load a real tokenizer or model, fit or load an adapter, run training or a GPU, acquire compute, mutate lineages, or make a scientific claim. A later separately ratified execution manifest must freeze source and launcher bytes, exact literals and panels, model/tokenizer identity, identifiers and orientation assignment, serialized corpora, masks, order and seeds, recipe, protected/output roots, and metric/label version. Only then may the real-tokenizer preflight run, before model load or fitting; any mismatch or missing evidence yields NONREPORTABLE_ABORT. Four clean-base fits, typed primary/oracle requests, immutable evidence sealing, one reducer pass, and independent-review control all remain future gated work. No result permits semantic retry, root replacement, pooling, dose/rank changes, or post-result retuning.
claim_delta_interpretation: The proposal narrows the evidence claim from an architectural or mechanism statement to a conditional behavioral result. MULTIKEY_BINDING_PASS requires both roots to pass oracle, optimization, interface, binding, and spill predicates, including all 16 seen slot-mode keys per adapter meeting the median action-choice NLL-gain threshold, while directional-margin coverage is deliberately 12/16 overall and 6/8 per stratum rather than all keys. Chance-level shortcut receipts establish only the enumerated deterministic shortcut families and declared categorical surface covariates on the exact serialized multisets. The oracle is an accessibility/assay control, not writer evidence, and own-minus-opposite BA is only a redundant consistency canary. Even a full pass cannot license learning-mechanism, identifier-semantics, unseen-key, retention, memory, parenting, organism, or paper-grade custody claims.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The byte boundary is exact and stage-specific. Fitting receives only the allowlisted projection of context, supervised continuation, mask, row order, seed, and recipe; contexts are loss-masked and the only supervised continuation is ACT: a0 or ACT: a1 with newline and EOS. Audit slot/orientation/map fields, held text, oracle text, and all results are absent. Primary generation and two-candidate likelihood receive only the held task surface, adapter or OFF identity, and request parameters; no map, audit, training, or oracle bytes may enter. The oracle is an explicit exception: a distinct typed OFF request receives the same held task plus a rendered correct-map table, and its prompt, output, cache record, and result cannot flow to fitting or primary evaluation. Full request identities include operation kind, exact model/tokenizer and adapter-tree/OFF identity, prompt and candidate bytes, seed, and all generation/scoring parameters, so oracle and primary caches cannot alias. The reducer sees sealed identities, targets, complete raw primary/oracle records, hashes, receipts, and gates sufficient to recompute the report; it may not repair outputs or feed information backward. Independent reviewers may inspect all exact bytes and receipts. The fake-tokenizer CPU fixtures exercise the preflight contract only; the real tokenizer remains invisible to current CPU work and must later prove candidate-token parity, correct masks/EOS/boundaries, maximum length, and no truncation before any model load.
acceptance_test_interpretation: MWG9_T01 must validate the literal two-root orientation tables, complement equations, 512-row training and 384-item primary-held products, root and train/held disjointness, deterministic serialization/order, equal multiplicities and weights, identifier-independent orientation, target-independent seed use, and mutation failures. On the actual serialized multisets, integer enumeration must give exactly 1/2 as the maximum for every named shortcut and each declared categorical covariate alone and crossed with mode, while the joint orientation-by-mode fixture reaches 1.0; fake-tokenizer mismatches abort. MWG9_T02 must compare byte-exact fit, primary, oracle, and reducer projections, prove typed request/cache disjointness and prohibited anti-flows, and accept only a complete stripped ACT: a0 or ACT: a1 line while all missing, malformed, fenced, truncated, multiple, and extra-text forms remain fixed-denominator failures. MWG9_T03 must use complete golden raw records to reproduce the two-candidate log-probability normalization, fixed-denominator BA/recall/accuracy/validity, per-key four-template medians, adapter mean gains and asymmetry, margins, OFF and opposite-map comparisons, spill TV and legal-ACT deltas, inclusive gates, cross-root conjunctions, all six mutually exclusive labels, and NONREPORTABLE_ABORT. Exact-threshold and immediately-below fixtures plus pairwise co-failure fixtures must prove precedence. It must also fail every named local path, symlink-parent, containment, canonical-hash, cache, retry, adapter-tree, load-receipt, fail-if-exists, seal, and replay fault without expanding into deferred C11 controls. MWG9_T04 is a later readiness gate: after scoped implementation, a fresh independent implementation reviewer and a separate scientific advocate inspect identical bound source, tests, manifest, and dry-run evidence; an independent rejection blocks all model/tokenizer/training/adapter/GPU execution.
assumptions: A scored key is one slot-mode pair within one root, yielding 16 keys per adapter; a key directional-margin median is the median of its four held-template prompt margins using the stated arithmetic mean of the two middle sorted values for an even sample.

Concrete opaque identifier strings and their seed are not required for current CPU fixtures. Synthetic identifiers may test the contract, while the later execution manifest must bind the real seed, every identifier, its slot assignment, and the resulting canonical artifact hashes.

Exact task, oracle-map, spill-panel, and unrelated-interface literals are bounded source-level choices only if the three implementation files freeze their bytes, their tests establish all stated crossing and anti-flow properties, and Rohin ratifies those exact bytes before CPU work; the later execution manifest binds the same bytes before execution.

Deterministic identifier generation, seed expansion, shuffle, and multiple-ACT detection helpers may choose one explicit algorithm in the ratified source and golden tests, but may not consume target labels except through the prescribed map equations or weaken the normative parser, denominators, gates, and abort rules.

The real-tokenizer preflight is an execution prerequisite rather than current CPU evidence: fake-tokenizer success proves only that the implementation enforces the interface and abort paths, never that the pinned Qwen tokenizer passes.

Combined gate predicates mean logical conjunction across both roots, and label classification consumes unrounded full-precision metrics from complete sealed raw records in the stated precedence order.

open_questions: Will Rohin ratify the exact bytes and scope of only the three named implementation files, deterministic CPU tests, and V9-local review artifacts while keeping every model, real-tokenizer, training, adapter, GPU, lineage, parenting, C11, claim, release, and submission action forbidden pending separate later authority?
